headline: Holo-Battle Sim Update
title: Holo-Battle Sim | Three new stages and Trial mode | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Holo-Battle Sim got a big endgame update in Aniimo. It adds three new element stages: Dark, Earth and Lightning, each with new first clear rewards. Every stage also gets a harder Trial difficulty with its own first clear and weekly rewards. A new Training Index pays out for Gizmos, random events and Alpha transformations. You need the Trailblazer one promotion. Ready for Trial? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Holo-Battle Sim update: new Dark, Earth and Lightning stages, a Trial difficulty with weekly rewards, and a Training Index; requires Trailblazer I.
